curated_selection_reference_scan.scope: Current external CURATED_*.json exact string references only; not an exhaustive scan of every historical review.

diagnostics.initial_failure: 20 setup errors from missing lineno on the new synthetic future-annotations AST node; corrected harness only.
diagnostics.passing_means: Observed old defects reproduced plus confirmed-still-open control; not acceptance of defective behavior.

findings.description: Failed or disabled recheck is indistinguishable from confirmed closed; full/partial close reports accepted_after_recheck and FLIP may open.
findings.reachability: Both managers: close request raises; subsequent get_open_trades raises or configured recheck is disabled. find_open_trade returns None, which close interprets as confirmation.

findings.description: Explicit missing trade ID can fall back to a different trade, including a same-instrument successor, and handle_position_action retargets CLOSE.
findings.reachability: A previously observed target vanishes before the mandatory recheck and exactly one other matching trade remains.

findings.description: A partial-close exception plus any observed unit decrease logs the requested close quantity, even if the observed reduction differs.
findings.reachability: Requested50 of100; independent observation has80 units. Existing code records accepted_after_recheck units50 without transaction attribution.

findings.description: General TIGHTEN forwards a less-protective stop without comparing the existing stop/direction; the separate graceful-shutdown stop helper does contain a non-worsening gate.
findings.reachability: A long trade with existing1.1 stop receives TIGHTEN stop1.0, which is passed unchanged to the fake dependent-order transport.

minimal_correction_design.compatibility: Keep old caller-facing optional lookup available only where unknown and missing both mean refuse. Use new typed status for close reconciliation and initial/open/flip admission; audit every caller. Do not globally replace None with a truthy result dict.
minimal_correction_design.identity: If an explicit ID was supplied, never fall back to another ID. Instrument fallback may exist only as a distinct explicit lookup policy when no ID was supplied.
minimal_correction_design.implementation_status: Proposal only. No original file edited; parent approval and separately reviewed tests/source-history transition required before any integration.
minimal_correction_design.observation: Successful complete open-trades response plus exact requested trade ID establishes open/closed; error, disabled read, malformed/incomplete response, duplicate identity or unusable units establishes unknown. Preserve original observation clock and requested identity.
minimal_correction_design.partial: Preserve requested and observed units separately. Only exact identity and an observed valid reduction establish reduced position state; a different amount remains partial/unattributed rather than silently claiming the requested quantity. Preserve any confirmed remainder.
minimal_correction_design.unknown: Do not assign0 remaining, claim accepted_after_recheck, record a successful quantity, or permit a FLIP open leg. Retain an uncertainty/pending reconciliation event. Do not immediately retry an ambiguous close blindly.

policy_distinctions: Specific stop distances, profit multipliers, partial percentages, fade confirmation and hold-past-horizon are policy choices; no winning values are inferred from the three paper episodes.
Frozen lab manager retains broker-stop/trailing/profit-lock/native time exits; absence of a local quote suppresses price-conditioned decisions but its scheduled close intent is still separate.

Historical S5 exit sweep tests old stop first and tightens trailing stop only after close, but last-available-bar settlement and exact barrier-price fills are approximations, not the strict native outcome/executable-fill contract.
No claim that these legacy account lanes are active in the current research-only runtime. No new frozen paper arithmetic was evaluated.
